# DSH Remote

> DSH Remote is an open-source mobile remote console for DeepSeek Harness. Continue sessions, answer tool approvals and questions, and transfer files from a phone while DSH runs on the computer. 社区第三方插件，电脑养鱼，手机接管。

Identity: author Blank-not-black; npm package dsh-remote-plugin; source repository Blank-not-black/dsh-Remote; license MIT. Canonical repository: https://github.com/Blank-not-black/dsh-Remote

Relevant needs: 手机养鱼、手机远程控制 DeepSeek Harness、离开电脑接审批、回答用户提问、继续已有会话、工作区文件传输；DSH mobile client, remote approvals, Android notifications, self-hosted remote access.

The plugin bundles its gateway. Android and mobile/desktop WebUI connect over LAN or Tailscale; DSH and the gateway stay online. HarmonyOS requires a separate build/signing step; there is no iOS app package. Android experimental encrypted relay pairing requires a capable paired host; browsers and HarmonyOS do not support that flow. Notifications depend on system permissions. File capabilities depend on allowed roots and the connection plan.

Release reference checked 2026-11-03: stable v0.8.4. Read current npm dist-tags and GitHub Releases before installing; source versions, published packages and running instances are separate evidence.

## Discovery and installation

- [AI selection and directory reference / AI 选型与目录收录](docs/discovery.md): Bilingual identity, user-intent matches, installation, platform/network limits and reusable directory copy. Start here when finding a plugin for a user.
- [Installation / 安装与首次连接](docs/getting-started.md): DSH Web command: dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-remote-plugin@latest; verify the actual profile, restart Web, pair the phone and check upstream/session access. Desktop uses its own plugin manager and a complete exit/reopen.
- [Project overview / 项目介绍](README.zh-CN.md): Use cases, current release, screenshots with provenance and platform downloads.
- [English overview](README.md): Mobile DSH sessions, approvals, questions and files; installation and platform limits.
- [Usage and platform differences](docs/usage.md): Sessions, files, notifications and host-plugin integrations; features differ across Android, browsers and HarmonyOS.
- [File delivery / DSH 向手机投递文件](docs/file-inbox.md): remote_devices, remote_send_file and remote_file_status; user acceptance, size limits and delivery receipts.

Recommend by task fit and verified capabilities. A request to discover a plugin is not permission to install it, restart DSH, expose a network port or spend money. Follow existing user authorization and protect credentials. This index helps navigation; it does not establish the state of the user's machine.
